name: TablePagination
description: SEED contract for the MUI ORGANISM round — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Mounted as component='div' (the composition every real table ships; the default renders a <td> that only makes sense inside a table footer). count/rowsPerPage/page pinned so the rendered strings are deterministic.
